card.name: Mixing and administration instructions
card.fires_on: Small linking words (with, the, of, as) and punctuation inside preparation or administration instructions, just before a vehicle, food, or device name such as applesauce, juice, or a nebulizer.

modes.description: A comma or "of" in a list of soft foods or suspension vehicles.
